25. Explain specifically how you believe:
From October 2025 through May 2026, I experienced disparate treatment by my supervisor, Denise Roberts. After I served as a witness in a coworker's EEO case on 09-22-2025 and sent a written objection to our overtime rotation policy on 10-05-2025, I began receiving fewer client-facing assignments and my approved telework days were reduced from two to zero without performance justification. Comments were made during staff meetings referencing the need for a "younger face" in presentations (statement by project lead Alan Chu on 01-19-2026), and I was replaced on a March 2026 client briefing by a significantly younger, less experienced male employee.

I identify as Asian (Indian) with a medium brown complexion and Hindu faith. In March 2026 (week of 03-22-2026), my request to swap a shift to observe a Hindu religious holiday was denied by Ms. Roberts despite documented instances of shift swaps granted for other religious observances; coworker Emily Park witnessed the discussion on 03-15-2026. With respect to disability, I provided medical documentation in November 2023 confirming Generalized Anxiety Disorder and requested a flexible start time and intermittent telework. In December 2025, Ms. Roberts and HR specialist Mark Reynolds denied the accommodation without engaging in an interactive process; as a result, I was issued a counseling memo for two minor late arrivals on 02-14-2026 that were not issued to similarly situated employees (e.g., Jamal Davis and Emily Park) when they arrived late under comparable circumstances.

I contacted EEO Counselor Elaine Brooks on 05-22-2026 and received the Notice of Right to File on 06-10-2026. I believe the adverse actions (denial of accommodation and telework, reduced opportunities, and counseling memo) were motivated by my race/national origin (Asian/Indian), color, sex (female), age (56), religion (Hindu), and were taken in reprisal for my prior protected activity (witness participation on 09-22-2025 and opposition to perceived discriminatory overtime practices on 10-05-2025).
